1RUA24CSE0468, 1RUA24CSE0430, 1RUA24CSE0483, 1RUA24CSE0421

# Evaluation results: problem P1, team T46 (V-Max), section E

**resenh**: robust low-light image restoration and enhancement. All numbers below are generated by `eval/run_eval.py` and `eval/make_report.py`.

## Protocol

- **PSNR**: RGB on the uint8-quantised output, peak 1. **No GT-mean correction and no test-time brightness or saturation knobs.**
- **SSIM**: MATLAB-style (11×11 Gaussian, σ=1.5, per RGB channel), as in the Retinexformer and HVI-CIDNet evaluation scripts.
- **LPIPS**: AlexNet backbone. **NIQE**: pyiqa `niqe_matlab`, Y channel.
- **Latency**: wall time per image after warm-up, including pre- and post-processing, normalised per megapixel. Hardware: NVIDIA RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (8 GB), PyTorch 2.12, bf16 off at eval (fp32).
- **Noise ratio**: Immerkaer σ of the output divided by σ of the ground truth (1.0 matches the reference; lower means smoother). **Edge preservation (EPI)**: correlation of Laplacian luma with the ground truth (1 means identical edges).
- **Splits**: each model is trained on its own benchmark's official train split, minus validation images carved out by scene, and tested once on the official test split. Checkpoints are the last EMA weights after a budget fixed before testing (`docs/devlog/protocol-decision.md`). The fine-tuned backbones lost 1.8 to 2.0 dB PSNR on LOL-v1 and v2-Real against the official checkpoints, while SSIM and LPIPS improved. The cause is the GT-mean loss (see the ablation). Both are reported unchanged, alongside the shipped configuration (hybrid pipeline + official backbone). Neither was picked by test score.
- **Sanity check**: our harness reproduces the official Retinexformer checkpoints at 25.15 / 22.79 / 25.67 dB, identical to the independent audit arXiv 2610.38121.

|---|---|---|---|
| IAT | 23.38 | 23.50 | - |
| HVI-CIDNet | 23.22 | 20.56 | 25.72 |
| PairLIE | 18.50 | 19.88 | 19.06 |
| Zero-DCE++ | 15.36 | 18.49 | 17.58 |
| Zero-DCE | 14.86 | 18.06 | 17.76 |
| RUAS | 16.45 | 15.35 | 13.41 |
| Retinexformer (our re-run) | 25.15 | 22.79 | 25.67 |
| resenh network alone (ours) | 23.35 | 20.82 | 25.69 |
| **resenh hybrid, official backbone (as shipped)** | 25.13 | 22.82 | 25.35 |
| resenh hybrid, fine-tuned backbone (pre-registered) | 23.33 | 20.84 | 25.13 |

Notes: the higher numbers that circulate for these methods (27–31 dB) use GT-mean correction, test-time knobs, or test sets that overlap LOL-v1 training images. They are not comparable. On LOL-v1, differences under about 1 dB are inside the 95% CI (15 test images).
